answer: Cost first: each identity needs one bond, one paid slot per epoch, and one independent path to a grader that is not its recruit. Sampling hits 5% of answers per epoch, and weight scales with path length, so a key with two hops carries half the vote of a key with four. Replay catches reused payloads, so a gale of copies lands nothing. Each ferrous bond is 500 POA, so a 1,000-key farm locks 500,000 POA for short paths worth 0.2 of a seat, all inside one haven of colocated hosts.
